property: Quote occurs in the supplied source
implementation: Exact or whitespace-collapsed string match; zero or multiple matches refused; offsets recomputed on audit
assumption: The supplied text is the right text

property: Source text is the one the certificate was built from
implementation: SHA-256 of the stored text compared with the certificate
assumption: The source is authoritative, complete or current

property: Evidence is bound to the stated claim part
implementation: Part references resolved by a fixed rule; invalid references reported; binding stored and recomputed (rules N1/3.2)
assumption: The model referenced the part it meant

implementation: Versioned rule re-run on audit; superseded versions replay under their own rule
assumption: The rule is the right rule for the task

implementation: Hash chain over ledger events; Ed25519 signature on the chain head
assumption: Signer key obtained outside the bundle

property: Ledger not rolled back or forked
implementation: Only against a checkpoint the auditor already holds
assumption: Auditor kept an earlier head; no public log exists

property: Quote means what it is filed as (stance, basis)
assumption: Model assignment; inverted polarity is accepted if filed so

property: Quote is about the claim's subject, scope and time
assumption: Model assignment; a wrong-entity quote is accepted if filed so

property: Qualifier is necessary rather than incidental
assumption: Model assignment; the largest measured source of lost recall
Only the supplied context is read
